description: This file defines the `AnalysisOrchestratorService` class, which coordinates the analysis pipeline for resumes and job matching, including ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestions, and recommendations. It interacts with several repositories and external services to process resumes, perform analysis, and generate recommendations.

classes.name: AnalysisOrchestratorService
classes.description: A service class that manages the entire resume analysis pipeline, including ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestions, and recommendations. It provides methods to run analysis asynchronously or synchronously, as well as initiating background tasks.

methods.name: None run_analysis_pipeline( self, analysis_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, text: Optional[str] = None, resume_id: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Core method executing the analysis pipeline: updates analysis status, fetches resume content if needed, evaluates ATS, extracts skills, stores findings, generates suggestions, updates status to complete, and creates recommendations.

methods.name: UUID start_analysis_for_resume( self, user_id: UUID, resume_id: int )
methods.description: Creates a new analysis entry for a resume and schedules the analysis pipeline to run in background tasks.

methods.name: UUID analyze_text(self, user_id: UUID, text: Optional[str], target_role: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Performs synchronous analysis of provided text, runs ATS checks, skill extraction, and stores results.

methods.name: None _create_recommendations(self, analysis_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, candidate_skills: List[str])
methods.description: Generates job recommendations based on candidate skills, recent jobs, and user preferences.
